title: File:Burning building in Vyshgorod after russian missile strike on November 23, 2022.jpg
desc:
Vyshhorod, Kyiv oblast: aftermath of the russian missile strikes.
In one of the districts russian missile struck into a 4-story civilian building.
22 resquires and 6 fire engines were involved in the resque operation.
35 persons were resqued.

There are 7 dead as of November 25, 2022
